rules.title: Photo guidelines
do: Use recent, clear photos of the candidate
Make the first photo show the face clearly, alone
Dress as you would to meet the other family
Use good light and a plain background
dont: Photos of someone else, celebrities or stock images
Group photos as the first photo
Heavy filters, face-changing edits, sunglasses or masks in the first photo
Text, phone numbers, social media names or watermarks on the photo
Photos of documents, objects, scenery or pets
rules.reviewed: Every photo is reviewed before others can see it.
